limitations: This is an original-image spot check of 12 distinct available levels, not a complete review of the 1000-record batch. It does not establish correctness of unsampled records.

Sampling takes the first, middle by available-record order, and last available level in each shard: 7006/7139/7252, 7253/7382/7485, 7511/7641/7756, and 7757/7879/8000. The final shard supplies three samples; no extra tail fill was needed.

All 12 originals were rendered directly at their indexed repository paths. Their file hashes match both index and candidate hashes. Source availability is 910 of 1000; the 90 missing levels were not visually assessed.

Repeated-observation warning: validation.json reports no repeated observations, and an independent exact-string count across the 910 available candidate observations also found none. Repeated boilerplate review notes are present, including a note used 220 times. Neither unique observations nor repeated caveats prove image inspection or semantic correctness; paraphrased repetition was not exhaustively assessed.

The eight taxonomy terms are candidate vocabulary for Royal Match, not accepted or calibrated Match labels. Blockers, colors, tubes and coverings are not empty gaps; stair_step concerns the playable boundary, and central_mass requires visible central blockers rather than an empty notch.
The water-like overlay at level 7641 leaves fine upper-right contents uncertain. Device names and game mechanics cannot be established merely from appearance.

All sampled verified_difficulty and verified_strategy fields remain unknown, verified_evidence is empty, and both hypothesis fields are null. No directly cited local difficulty or strategy evidence was supplied or established by this visual sample.

Supported means only that the sampled visible description and assigned geometry are reasonably supported, not that the row is accepted. Every row remains needs_review. Corrections are proposals preserved here alongside conflicts; candidate shards, validation, index, source images and historical records were not changed.
